#170 round-2 deadline closure: superseded, not extended

Request 01a1b8a5-36e6-7ef3-95b2-e8fb72350039 concerned head 060ef066847a0ef1882976a04291ab149681dce1. The PM explicitly held it in message eec2e1c08c2219cc-0000000000000064 and instructed waiting for the macOS-only round-3 head if no verdict had been written. No round-2 verdict was written or published.

Round 3 replaced that request. Round 4 completed the review at b69cf96b6a6b6e9938f40a35f66ba66113fb4f52 with PASS-WITH-NOTES: comment 6715553961, writer commit 96ad81213ed5c580d1ad49c75c0c6ca2ce32b6dc. The exact-head index currently contains reviewer, security and performance verdicts at that final head.

The old request remained uncorrelated when it was held, so its deadline check-in does not describe unfinished review work. This note answers only that superseded request; it does not assign a verdict to 060ef06, reopen #170 or extend the deadline. No longer review period is needed. Await a fresh authorized assignment.
